name: skill
does: Openings and poise, a prototype, on by default: after it attacks a hare, badger or dormouse sits still for a moment, enough letters during its wind-up break its poise (the attack cancelled, a stagger, then a slowing daze), and an amber outline shows while it is open. A letter is still one hit. ?skill=0 turns it off, the fights as they were; =1 is on. Sets tuning skill.on.
decision: Ed, 2026-11-17: "Put the switches on by default and then publish"; earlier that day: "go for the prototype" (docs/plans/combat-skill-and-commands.md, section 5)
